description: BlueRock for Builders — the builder toolkit for Claude Code. Say 'score Acme Corp' and a two-agent team hands you a one-page account scorecard; set it up once and it runs your priorities and your session wrap-up, all on your own files. Part of the BlueRock for Builders program at builders.bluerock.io.

plugins.name: bluerock
plugins.description: Point a two-agent team at a company and get a one-page Account Scorecard — Fit, Timing, Reachability, and the recommended next step. Plus your daily rhythm: onboarding that learns who you are and how you write, a living to-do, and an end-of-day wrap-up that refreshes your dashboard. Your Hub comes seeded with more agents and skills you own and edit. Everything writes plain markdown into your own repo. Say what you want, or use commands like /bluerock:scorecard.
